Drop a plan here to start
Drag & drop a PDF or image, paste a screenshot with Ctrl+V, or click to browse. Or pick a saved plan above.
  1. Upload your plan set (PDF from CAD gives the best accuracy).
  2. Calibrate: draw over a known dimension, or pick the drawing scale. Then ✓ verify with a second dimension.
  3. Mark up: red = remove, green = add, blue = note. Dimensions and areas read out live as you draw.
  4. Export a full-quality PDF for the client and a takeoff CSV for pricing.
Press ? anytime for keyboard shortcuts · Ctrl+scroll to zoom

⧉ PDF Merge -- High Quality Re-export
Upload multiple PDFs. Drag to reorder pages. Each page is rendered at high resolution (300 DPI equivalent) then exported as a single merged PDF.
No PDFs added yet -- click Add PDF Files above
◈ 3D Isometric View -- Instant from Redline Marks
Opens your current redline plan in a live isometric 3D view. Rectangles become rooms, lines become walls. Use the controls to adjust wall height and style.
Click Generate to render your plan in isometric 3D. Rectangles from the redline tool become rooms.
⬡ 3D Room Builder -- Draw & Navigate
Draw room outlines below, set wall heights and add doors/windows, then switch to 3D to navigate a live perspective view. Use mouse to orbit · scroll to zoom.
Draw room: click to add corners · double-click to close room
✦ AI Render Export -- Plan → Photorealistic Render Prompt
Upload any floor plan (PDF or image) or capture your current redline plan. Claude reads the plan then generates a detailed photorealistic render prompt for Midjourney, DALL·E, or Firefly.
